title: Spankie Jackzon wins Down Under Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (DU-S02-E08), Hannah Conda, Kween Kong, and Spankie Jackzon lip-synced to Kylie Minogue's "Wow". Spankie Jackzon was crowned Down Under's next Drag Superstar.

title: Faúx Fúr: Season 2 Porkchop
summary: Faúx Fúr was the first contestant eliminated on Down Under Season 2 (DU-S02-E01), lip-syncing to Kylie Minogue's "Get Outta My Way" against Spankie Jackzon.

title: Team BAB'Z sweeps Bosom Buddies
summary: In DU-S02-E05, Team BAB'Z (Hannah Conda, Kween Kong, and Spankie Jackzon) all won the "Bosom Buddies" girl-group challenge — the season's only three-way maxi win.
